# Buffer

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Each feature grown by a distance on the ground (shrunk, for a negative one), as turf.buffer.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "buffer", "name": "buffer", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:radius`, or read elsewhere as `ch('buffer/radius')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Port | Type | Takes |
|------|------|-------|
| `in` | `table` | one edge |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Parameters

<!-- gen:begin params -->
| Parameter | Kind | Default | Choices |
|-----------|------|---------|---------|
| `radius` | `float` | `1` |  |
| `units` | `menu` | `"kilometers"` | `kilometers`, `meters`, `miles`, `nauticalmiles`, `feet`, `degrees` |
| `steps` | `int` | `8` |  |
<!-- gen:end params -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Port | Type |
|------|------|
